videos.title: How We Talk Shapes What We Share | Mahnaz Lashkri | TEDxEuropean University Institute Florence
videos.author: TEDx Talks
videos.description:
Rivers do not stop at borders, so who decides how their water is shared? 
Mahnaz Lashkri turns to transnational water governance, one of the world’s most contested resources, and shows how the way we talk shapes what we share. A resource that crosses borders needs conversations that cross them too.
